weakness: No MFA on the ATS; email MFA by phishable SMS codes; partner portal code sent to the email
remediation_plan: Authenticator-app MFA with number matching on email; MFA on the ATS; ask the partner for authenticator-app codes; recovery codes into the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-15 email and ATS MFA on and tested; 2026-09-30 partner answer recorded

weakness: SSNs, dates of birth, ID images, and consumer reports kept with no purpose in email, the laptop, and the phone; no retention schedule
source: P07 assessment (SI-12 objectives); P03 G-037, G-038, G-061, G-112
remediation_plan: Partner confirms in writing that it holds every start form; then delete all start forms, SSNs, and ID images, empty deleted items, and repeat the search; adopt POL-01 8.6; quarterly re-search
milestones: 2026-09-15 partner confirmation; 2026-10-15 purge complete and verified by a repeat search; 2026-10-31 ATS records older than 3 years with no activity deleted
resources_required: Owner time (6 hours); IT technician 1 hour (about $90)

weakness: Reused ATS password; passwords in the browser; no lost-phone or compromise procedure; router default password (changed 2026-07-23)
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases for every account; recovery procedure for a lost phone; change passwords after any vendor breach notice
milestones: 2026-09-15 password manager in use and browser store cleared

weakness: Partner agreement has no security or breach notice terms and the partner accepts forwarded bank changes; AI vendor terms allow training on candidate data; no vendor list; ATS SOC 2 report not requested
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-023, G-026, G-111
remediation_plan: Vendor list (POL-01 6.2); partner security addendum (10-day breach notice; named contact; bank changes only through contractor self-service or call-back; annual SOC 2); AI training opt-outs; request the ATS vendor's SOC 2 report
milestones: 2026-09-30 written bank-change request sent to the partner and AI opt-outs on; 2026-10-31 vendor list and ATS report request; 2026-11-30 addendum signed
resources_required: Owner time; counsel review of the addendum about $500

weakness: Email and ATS logs never reviewed; no sign-in alerts
remediation_plan: New-sign-in alerts on; monthly review on the first business day using a one-page checklist; weekly review for 3 months after any incident or phishing attempt
milestones: 2026-09-15 alerts on; 2026-10-01 first monthly review logged

weakness: No incident reporting duty, notification contact list, or knowledge of the Florida clocks
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-095, G-109
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts; walk through it with the IT technician; register a breach contact with each vendor
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted; 2026-09-30 contacts printed and walkthrough held

weakness: No disposal step for electronic consumer information; past device disposal not recorded
remediation_plan: Delete the 2 consumer reports and record the disposal; written request to clients not to send reports; device disposal rule and log (POL-01 8.7)
milestones: 2026-09-15 reports deleted and recorded; 2026-09-30 client letters sent

weakness: No independent copy of ATS data; ATS vendor backups unconfirmed
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a., CP-09b., CP-09d.[03]); P03 G-064
remediation_plan: Monthly full ATS export saved to the file storage; quarterly test that an export opens and is complete; ask the ATS vendor for its backup terms

weakness: No required phone settings or guidance; ID photos were in the camera roll; remote erase untested
remediation_plan: Phone rules in POL-01 Appendix A; test remote erase with the IT technician; sign out of the ATS app and use the browser
milestones: 2026-10-31 remote erase tested and settings recorded

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual July review and change triggers; first update July 2027
